Kamala Harris campaigns with Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan

US Vice President Kamala Harris campaigned alongside Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, endorsing him and calling for Democratic unity ahead of the 2026 midterms. El-Sayed emphasized a focus on health during the campaign event. The visit and speech generated online discussion, with some critics focusing on a perceived change in Harris's delivery.
